decision: Approve the section-register and section-content-wrap conventions for the coordinated section frame register and its optional centered content wrapper.

evidence.interpretation: The owner approved both naming conventions in gate 3 of the SectionShell v0.1 plan. The whole-file plan SHA-256 is 0b62bfd213b8cca5337a616457e904f1d1059bbd52891ef61489b72a3b66fc2e; the exact entry text is in section 5. Not native review authority.

convention.name: register
convention.meaning: The combined visual register selected for a section frame; values and recipes are component-specific.
convention.whenToUse: Select a section's coordinated scene and material treatment.
convention.avoid: Do not use for a color tone alone, a generic visual variant or choreography.

convention.name: wrap
convention.meaning: Whether a section frame supplies its own centered content wrapper.
convention.whenToUse: Choose whether section children receive the section content max-width and gutters.
convention.avoid: Do not use for flex wrapping, a gap, padding alone or a portal container.
